scope: Definition/measurement audit over all currently released canonical quantitative observations and the phase1 programme/local statistical cells. No raw numeric values or IDs are changed.

statuses.published_panel_limited: Same official table explicitly presents multiple periods with the same printed metric/unit and population/region qualifiers; permits that published comparison only, not a claim that all historic collection rules were unchanged.
statuses.source_series_only: Same source-labelled series; missing effective-year definition prevents full comparability certification.
statuses.incompatible: Explicit unit/measure, period, population, national-library inclusion, geography, aggregation, institution or dimension conflict.
statuses.unresolved: Necessary original definition/effective date or scope remains unknown; same label is not evidence.

source_facts_only: Do not infer an effective date from today's dictionary; do not claim statistical correctness, causal comparison or continuity of reporting completeness.
protected_values: 0/blank/marker/display-typed0 conflict/period conflict keep all original representations. 2012 original quantities remain a gap; never impute.
delivery: CSV/JSONL/SQLite record annotation + definition/evidence register + comparison groups/breakpoints, evidence-qualified CLI pair checker and readable overview. Preserve canonical data unchanged. No automatic cross-family splicing or geography recoding.
publishing: Validate then update the existing GitHub repository, latest release, packaged readers and private Drive handoff; retain old tags/releases.
